description.en: ISS altitude. Closest view of the ground and easy to reach, but thin air drags you down: you need propellant to stay up.
description.zh-TW: 國際太空站的高度。離地面最近、最容易抵達，但稀薄大氣會把衛星往下拖，要帶推進劑才能維持軌道。

source.title: U.S. Standard Atmosphere 1976 (NASA NTRS); Adell (NASA-JPL) total dose table; Knap et al. 2020 Table 6
source.note: estimate: drag dv ~57 m/s/yr at moderate solar activity (a = 0.5 rho v^2 Cd A/m, A/m = 0.01), game value 50; ~1-2 yr natural decay without reboost; dose 0.2 krad/yr (below the 1 krad/yr generic LEO value because 400 km sits under most of the inner belt); DoD 10-40% LEO (sourced); 4 passes/day of ~6 min for a 51.6 deg orbit (estimate)

name.zh-TW: 太陽同步軌道（700 公里）

description.en: The Landsat / OCO orbit. Passes over every place at the same local time, so lighting is consistent. Almost no drag.
description.zh-TW: Landsat 與 OCO 用的軌道。每天同一個地方時經過同一地點，光照條件一致，幾乎沒有大氣阻力。

source.title: OCO launch press kit (NASA/JPL 2009); Adell (NASA-JPL) total dose table
source.note: sourced: 705 km, 98.2 deg, 99 min period, passes 5-12 min (game 8); dose 'Earth (LEO-1 year) 1 krad' behind 100 mil Al. estimate: dv ~2 m/s/yr (drag ~0.6 + inclination upkeep), beta 25 deg typical for a 10:30 node, 9 passes/day for a ~65 deg N station, decades of natural lifetime

name.zh-TW: 地球同步軌道（35,786 公里）

description.en: Hovers over one spot and sees a whole hemisphere all day, but from 90x farther away, through harsh radiation, and needs a big rocket.
description.zh-TW: 停在同一點上空，整天看著半個地球；但距離遠 90 倍、輻射很強，還需要大火箭。

source.title: Kim et al., Station-Keeping for COMS Satellite, J. Astron. Space Sci. 23(3) 2006; Adell (NASA-JPL); Knap et al. 2020 Table 6
source.note: sourced: N-S 52.71 + E-W 3.50 m/s/yr (game 55); 'Earth (GEO-1 year) 30 krad'; GEO 90 cycles/yr, DoD 60-80% (game 75%). estimate: 10x lower downlink rate from 36,000 km after bigger ground antennas, 95% contact time, ~1 yr of usable drift without station keeping

description.en: Lunar Reconnaissance Orbiter territory. Lumpy lunar gravity pulls the orbit down fast, and every byte has to cross 384,000 km to the Deep Space Network.
description.zh-TW: 月球勘測軌道衛星（LRO）的高度。月球重力不均勻，軌道很快就會往下掉；每筆資料都要飛 38 萬公里回到深空網路。

source.title: Lauinger, Cotten & Zee, Optimization of Orbit-Maintenance Strategies for Small Satellites in Cislunar Space (SmallSat 2026); NASA MOCS D-22674
source.note: sourced: 50 km polar needs 10.5 m/s per lunation, consistent with LRO. estimate: ~50 m/s/yr at 100 km, months of natural lifetime, 2 krad/yr (no trapped belts), one 4 h DSN track per day, 20x lower rate than near-Earth
